API Reference ​

Every method of skapi-py 2.4.0. Each one raises SkapiError on failure.

Connection ​

method
Skapi(project_id, *, storage=None, timeout=120, encryption=None)connects to one project
get_connection_info(refresh=False)project name and settings

Authentication ​

method
signup(params, option=None)creates an account
resend_signup_confirmation()sends the confirmation e-mail again
login(email, password, username=None)signs in
verify_mfa(code)finishes a login that needs an authenticator code
logout(global_logout=False)signs out
get_profile(refresh_token=False)the signed-in user's profile
login_with_token(id_token, access_token, refresh_token)adopts tokens from another sign-in
update_profile(params)changes the user's profile
change_password(current_password, new_password)changes the password
forgot_password(email)sends a password reset code
reset_password(email, code, new_password)sets a new password with the code
verify_email(code=None)sends or checks an e-mail verification code
last_verified_email(revert=None)the last verified e-mail
disable_account()disables the user's own account
recover_account(redirect=False)sends the recovery e-mail to a disabled account
open_id_login(token, id)signs in through an OpenID provider
anonymous_login()a temporary account without e-mail or password
verify_anonymous_session()checks a restored temporary account still exists
setup_mfa() / enable_mfa(code) / disable_mfa() / get_mfa_status()two-step login with an authenticator app

Database ​

method
post_record(data, config, files=None)creates or updates a record
post_records(items)many records in few requests
get_records(query, fetch_options=None)reads records
delete_records(query)deletes records
get_tables / get_tags / get_indexes / get_unique_idwhat the database holds
upload_files(files, record_id)attaches files to a record
get_file(url, config=None)downloads a file, or makes a link to it
delete_files(endpoints)removes files from records
grant_private_record_access / remove_private_record_access / list_private_record_access / request_private_record_access_keysharing private records

Encryption ​

method
get_encryption_status()locked, unlocked or disabled
unlock_encryption(password) / lock_encryption()opens or forgets the user's keys
unlock_encryption_with_recovery_code(code, password=None) / regenerate_encryption_recovery_code()encryption recovery codes (the first one is shown once in get_connection_info())
pin_peer_key(user_id, fingerprint)trusts another user's key for sharing
is_withheld(value)tells the placeholder of undecryptable data apart

Users ​

method
get_users(params=None, fetch_options=None)searches the project's users
subscribe(params) / unsubscribe(params)subscribes to another user
block_subscriber(params) / unblock_subscriber(params)blocks a subscriber
get_subscriptions(params)who subscribes to whom
get_feed(params=None)records from the users you subscribe to
subscribe_newsletter(params) / unsubscribe_newsletter(group)newsletter subscription
get_newsletters(params=None) / get_newsletter_subscription()sent newsletters and the user's subscriptions
send_inquiry(data)sends a message to the project owner

Realtime ​

method
connect_realtime(callback) / close_realtime()opens or closes the realtime connection
join_realtime(group)joins or leaves a group
post_realtime(message, recipient, notification=None)sends to a user or to the group
get_realtime_groups(params=None) / get_realtime_users(params=None)who is connected where

API Bridge ​

method
forward_request(options, form=None, on_stream=None)calls another API through Skapi, with your client secrets
forward_request_poll(request_id) / forward_request_stream(request_id)waits for a queued or streamed answer
forward_request_finalize(request_id, data)stores a streamed request's final answer
forward_request_history(params)past forwarded requests and their answers
cancel_forward_request(params) / forward_request_queue_count(params)queue control

Tickets ​

method
consume_ticket(ticket_id, method, data, auth)calls a ticket
get_tickets(params=None)the project's tickets
get_consumed_tickets(params=None)the user's own ticket calls
